item.title: Louisiana-Pacific proposes $157M plant in North Branch
item.description: Louisiana-Pacific plans a $157M wood products plant in North Branch, seeking Minnesota Forward Fund aid to create 100 jobs at its new flagship site.

item.title: Agency sues Trump administration over Hudson Tunnel Project funding
item.description: The Gateway Development Commission is suing the Trump administration over $205 million in withheld funding for the $16B Hudson River rail tunnel project.

item.title: Uncertainty persists despite higher productivity, Fed’s Barkin says
item.description: Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin says higher productivity is helping curb inflation but warns it’s volatile, reinforcing the Fed’s pause on rate cuts.

item.title: Trump’s 250-foot arch proposal draws scrutiny from architects
item.description: President Trump favors a towering 250-foot Independence Arch for America’s 250th anniversary, raising concerns about scale, views and historic impact.

item.title: U.S. and India finalize trade deal after months of tension
item.description: The U.S. and India finalized a trade deal cutting tariffs after months of tension, easing strains over Russian oil and boosting bilateral trade ties.

item.title: Business groups sue over Port Washington TID referendum
item.description: MMAC and construction groups filed a lawsuit seeking to block a Port Washington referendum requiring voter approval for large tax incremental districts.

item.title: Northwestern Mutual to grow workforce with St. Cloud office expansion
item.description: Northwestern Mutual’s St. Cloud branch is completing a $1.8 million office expansion, adding space for training and up to 20 new advisers.

item.title: Lupe plans 296 apartments at former American Legion site
item.description: Lupe Development proposes 296 mostly affordable apartments at the former American Legion site in Richfield, revising plans with lower height and more parking.

item.title: 438-unit St. Paul apartment complex sells for $65.3M
item.description: Chicago-based Highgate Capital Group bought the 438-unit Burlington Apartments in St. Paul for $64.3 million, marking its first Twin Cities deal.

item.title: Just Sold: Limited supply buoys small apartment sales
item.description: A 23-unit Minneapolis apartment building sold for $2.6 million, while CommonBond refinanced a Newport property to renovate 78 affordable housing units.
